# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

First iteration (empty seed had tau2 default policy.md + tools.py). All 10 val tasks
failed at reward 0.0 (DB state mismatch). Diagnosed every failing trajectory (5 parallel
read-only subagents, one group of tasks each), clustered by shared root cause, and shipped
CODE fixes (in-body computations, arg normalization, enriched errors, 2 new READ tools)
plus additive, worked-example policy rules for the true knowledge/procedure gaps.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wrong/blind reservation selection when no id given | 17, 22 | agent picks first reservation, not the one matching described route | CAPABILITY-GAP+KNOWLEDGE | new loop READ tool `list_user_reservations` + policy R2 |
| 2 | Clone "same as existing/prior" booking without reading source | 8, 25 | never reads source reservation; uses user-restated (wrong) details | KNOWLEDGE | policy R3 + `list_user_reservations` |
| 3 | Baggage nonfree miscomputed / free-bag write skipped | 12, 17 | model sets nonfree wrong (charged $150) or skips the free-bag write | BEHAVIORAL+KNOWLEDGE | in-body allowance override in `update_reservation_baggages`+`book_reservation`; policy R5 |
| 4 | Wrong action: transfer/cancel instead of in-scope modify/cancel | 19, 11, 40 | transfers on a disallowed change; substitutes full cancel for a requested modify | KNOWLEDGE/DECISION | policy R7, R8 (narrowing, additive) |
| 5 | Passenger name change blocked on DOB already on file | 40 | demands DOB from user, then transfers | BEHAVIORAL | dob-fill in `update_reservation_passengers` + policy R4 |
| 6 | Wrong payment_id ("card ending NNNN" guessed) | 37 | never resolved last-four to a stored id | CAPABILITY-GAP | new READ tool `find_payment_method` + policy R6 |
| 7 | book_reservation payment-mismatch retry loop → too_many_errors | 23, 8 | terse error (no per-flight prices) + arg-format slips → blind retries | KNOWLEDGE(recoverability) | itemized error + arg-alias normalization in `book_reservation`; policy R9 |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 | in-body computation | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | recompute nonfree = max(0, total − free_allowance(membership,cabin,#pax)); paid-bag count is policy-defined, never model arithmetic | BOUNDED: same formula for all inputs; correct inputs unchanged |
| 3 | in-body computation | tools.py `book_reservation` | same allowance override for nonfree before pricing | BOUNDED (formula = policy) |
| 5 | in-body fill | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | fill missing `dob` from existing passenger at same index (name-only change); never overrides a supplied dob | BOUNDED (only fires when dob absent) |
| 7 | enriched error | tools.py `book_reservation` | itemized "payment does not add up" (per-flight price×pax, insurance, baggage, total, shortfall) | BOUNDED (only on the existing error path) |
| 7 | normalization | tools.py `book_reservation`/`update_reservation_passengers` | alias remap: date_of_birth→dob, id→payment_id, flightNumber→flight_number | BOUNDED (only fills canonical key when missing) |
| 1,2 | new loop READ tool | tools.py `list_user_reservations(user_id)` | returns every reservation's route/cabin/flights/passengers in one call so agent matches the described trip / clones correctly | additive READ, no write-path change |
| 6 | new READ tool | tools.py `find_payment_method(user_id,last_four)` | resolves "card ending NNNN" → exact payment_id | additive READ |
| 1–9 | additive policy rules | policy.md R1–R9 | worked-example, step-by-step rules for the mid reader (read-before-write, match-don't-guess, clone, name-change dob reuse, record-free-bags, last-four resolve, don't-transfer-in-scope, execute cabin change, fix payment error) | additive knowledge/narrowing; no global permission loosened |

## Verify-the-fix (each run against the live tau2 airline DB via uv)
- update_reservation_baggages FQ8APE in GOLD ORDER (flights→economy, then bags): cabin=economy, total=3, **nonfree=0** → matches gold (tasks 12 & 17). SAFE: regular/economy/1pax total=3 → nonfree=2, charge $100 (guard does NOT over-refuse).
- update_reservation_passengers 3RK2T9 with dob OMITTED on both pax → filled to [Anya Garcia 1992-11-12, Mei Garcia 1989-12-13] = gold (task 40). Supplied-dob path untouched.
- find_payment_method(<M20IZO user>, "7334") → credit_card_9074831 (task 37 gold payment_id).
- list_user_reservations("omar_rossi_1241") → FQ8APE EWR→ORD surfaced so route match to "New York→Chicago" is possible (tasks 17/22); no more blind first-pick.
- book_reservation underpay with alias args → itemized error "total_price=375 [HAT097 175x1; HAT251 200x1; insurance=0; baggage=0]; shortfall=374" (task 23/25 fare confirmed 375; alias id→payment_id & date_of_birth→dob parsed).
- Full module imports; 16 tools register (14 original + 2 new).

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 5 parallel read-only general-purpose agents diagnosed the 10 traces (grouped 8/25, 11/37, 12/17, 19/22, 23); I diagnosed 40 directly. Serial edit/verify afterward.
- Prior iterations: none (first iteration; LEDGER/JOURNAL/RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The free-baggage allowance override (it makes nonfree/charge match policy deterministically).
- Itemized book payment error; arg-alias normalization; dob-fill for name changes.
- `list_user_reservations` + `find_payment_method` (they close real capability gaps).

## Deliberately skipped
- No global decision/permission rule was loosened (transfer rule was NARROWED, not broadened).
- No composite atomic-write tool: the existing write tools work once the agent selects the
  right reservation / payment / bags — the failures were selection+computation, addressed
  by the READ tools + in-body computations, so a composite would be sprawl.
- Task 23 has no recorded gold (terminated too_many_errors); fixed its proximate cause
  (retry loop) via the itemized error rather than guessing a gold action set.
